posts_ends_after_start.name: posts_ends_after_start
posts_ends_after_start.value: "posts"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "posts"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "posts"."ends_at" >= "posts"."starts_at"

course_links_one_target.name: course_links_one_target
course_links_one_target.value:
("course_links"."kind" = 'URL') = ("course_links"."url" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("course_links"."kind" = 'FILE') = ("course_links"."file_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("course_links"."kind" = 'INTERNAL') = ("course_links"."internal_target" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("course_links"."kind" = 'POST') = ("course_links"."post_id" IS NOT NULL)

course_links_period.name: course_links_period
course_links_period.value: "course_links"."visible_until" IS NULL OR "course_links"."visible_from" IS NULL OR "course_links"."visible_until" > "course_links"."visible_from"
